title: Anthropic logged net loss of over $80 billion in first half of 2026, WSJ reports
source: Anthropic logged a net loss of more than $80 billion in the first half. Most of the loss is non-cash accounting charges. In 2025 the company posted a net loss of $42 billion. It plans to spend $518 billion on cloud and computing obligations.
headline: Anthropic logged an $80 billion net loss.
body: Anthropic logged a net loss of more than $80 billion in the first half.
why: ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent change which buyers can get Nvidia chips.

title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
source: MiniMax says the model is 3x faster. A benchmark score is listed on the model card. Flat pricing per 1M tokens is $0.15 for input and $0.60 for output.
headline: MiniMax cuts usage cost by 70%.
why: Useful since the scores are company-reported.

title: Nvidia-backed Nscale, Anthropic in talks for new $45 billion AI cloud deal
preview: Nscale is in talks with Anthropic.
source: Nscale is in talks with Anthropic on a cloud deal worth about $45 billion. The talks cover a second site that would use Nvidia chips.
headline: Nscale and Anthropic are in talks on a $45 billion deal.
body: Nscale is in talks with Anthropic on a cloud deal worth about $45 billion. The talks cover a second site that would use Nvidia chips.

title: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent order more than $35 billion of Nvidia chips
preview: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent ordered Nvidia chips.
source: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered Nvidia chips priced at more than $35 billion. The orders are for inference hardware the companies cannot fill with older stock.
headline: ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent ordered $35 billion of Nvidia chips.
body: ByteDance, Alibaba and Tencent have ordered Nvidia chips priced at more than $35 billion. The orders are for inference hardware the companies cannot fill with older stock.
why: The Nscale deal changes how much compute Anthropic can buy.

title: Microsoft introduces Guardian Agents for enterprise security
source: Microsoft introduced Guardian Agents to monitor the agents a company uses. Defender can find up to 60 types of agents. Hayete Gallot wrote that frontier models cannot be trusted.
headline: Microsoft's Guardian Agents cover 60 agent types.
